name: atlan
description: Atlan's plugins for coding agents: the Atlan registry's MCP server, the skills to use it, and workloads built on it.

metadata.description: Atlan's plugins for coding agents: the Atlan registry's MCP server, the skills to use it, and workloads built on it.

plugins.name: atlanai
plugins.description: Your organization's skills, agents, knowledge and MCP servers, from the Atlan registry. One sign-in, no API key.

plugins.name: atlanai-analytics
plugins.description: Prepare a link, local folder or BI export for talk-to-data in Claude or Codex: survey dashboards and query history, select scope, preview metrics and SQL, publish to Atlan and ask questions from released context. Also supports warehouse analytics, business ontology and explicit agent workflows.

plugins.name: atlanai-mods
plugins.description: Claude Code mod for the Atlan registry: registry reads run without a prompt, writes ask first, archive and move show what depends on the artifact, temporary gateway errors tell Claude how to retry, Atlan calls read as one line in the transcript, a pane lists what the session touched, a band follows a skill publish, /atlan skills picks a skill to load, a registry skill that clearly fits a request is named to Claude, and the status line reports a broken or degraded Atlan connection.

plugins.name: atlanai-analytics-view
plugins.description: Native Analytics source overview, metric evidence and progress pane for Claude Code. Shows only supplied presentation data and fills prompts on explicit button clicks.
